subject: Mathematical Foundations for Machine Learning
summary: The chapter is conceptually coherent, accessible, and substantially improved. Word-count and code-execution evidence pass, but citation placement, remaining independent review gates, and rendered heading/accessibility QA are incomplete.

headingAssessment.requiredAction: Confirm that the page layout renders the frontmatter title as exactly one visible H1 before the classification notice; otherwise add one body H1 without adding a duplicate title heading.

findings.finding: The MDX body contains no H1, so title hierarchy depends on the page layout.
findings.requiredCorrection: Verify exactly one rendered H1 on desktop and mobile and preserve heading-audit evidence.

findings.finding: Frontmatter and word-count-validation.json agree on 4299 meaningful prose words, above the 3000-word threshold.
findings.requiredCorrection: Re-run the validator after any prose change.

findings.finding: code-validation.md/json records byte-for-byte execution on Python 3.14.6 and NumPy 2.3.4 with seven of seven tests passing.
findings.requiredCorrection: Re-run validation after any code change; do not infer a complete compatibility matrix from one recorded environment.

findings.finding: Authentic bibliography entries are not attached closely enough to externally checkable claims.
findings.requiredCorrection: Apply all claim-level corrections in citation-review.md and retain citationStatus partial until reverified.

findings.finding: The shape (b,) versus (b,k) broadcasting example leaves the b == k exception implicit.
findings.requiredCorrection: State that numerical compatibility when b == k still does not establish intended axis semantics.

findings.finding: The ndarray definition is overly absolute and the approximate-equality rule is not identified as NumPy's asymmetric isclose convention.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use 'usually fixed-size' and identify b as the reference value in NumPy isclose.

findings.finding: Independent mathematics, citation, editorial, code, accessibility, and rendered-QA gates are not complete.
findings.requiredCorrection: Keep approval false and publication blocked until traceable evidence for every gate is available.

strengths: Explicit symbol, shape, and vector-orientation conventions.
Dimensionally coherent affine derivation and worked example.
Careful separation of educational interpretation from local engineering guidance.

Probability ownership remains outside this chapter.
